## Checking a box means you have reviewed this aspect and take responsibility for it.
### Short description
- [ ] The PR description is clear and helps the reviewer quickly understand the change and its scope
### Coding conventions
- [ ] Code is readable, naming is clear, and follows team conventions
### Error handling
- [ ] Errors are handled properly (no swallowed errors, sufficient logging for debugging)
### Security matter
- [ ] No new security risks introduced (validation, permission, data exposure)
### Performance matter
- [ ] No obvious performance bottlenecks or unnecessary processing introduced
### Backward compatibility
- [ ] No unintended breaking changes; rollback is safe
